publications.title: A JoLT for the KV Cache
publications.authors: Rahul Krishnan and Volker Schulz, Universitaet Trier
publications.description: My MSc thesis preprint reports near-lossless 2x to 3x KV cache compression, with accuracy staying within 2 percentage points of the uncompressed model, across five models and four model families.
publications.result: At 3x compression GSM8K moves -1.21 pp on Mistral-7B and RULER 64K moves -0.10 pp on LLaMA-3.1-8B, with perplexity within 0.3% of dense on all five models. The FlashJoLT fused decode kernel cuts peak decode KV memory by 3.61x.

publications.title: Tensor Decomposition of Transformer Key-Value Caches: Spectral Structure and Format Comparison
publications.authors: Rahul Krishnan and Volker Schulz, Universitaet Trier
publications.conference: arXiv preprint, in preparation for Numerical Linear Algebra with Applications (NLAA)
publications.description: A companion to the JoLT paper that treats the KV cache as a fourth-order tensor, measures its singular-value spectra on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and LLaMA-2-13B, and compares Tucker, CP, tensor train and t-SVD at matched storage.
publications.result: Token and feature modes are low-rank while head and layer modes are nearly full-rank. Tucker has the lowest reconstruction error at every compression ratio from 2x to 5x, and post-RoPE keys lose 41% to 64% of their pre-RoPE compressibility.

publications.title: Glaucoma Detection from Retinal Fundus Images
publications.authors: Rahul Krishnan, Varun Sekhar, J. Sidharth, S. Gautham, and G. Gopakumar
publications.conference: International Conference on Communication and Signal Processing (ICCSP)
publications.description: Undergraduate research on automated glaucoma screening from retinal fundus images using optic-disc and optic-cup segmentation with SVM classification.
publications.result: Achieved an F1 score of 86% on the Drishti-GS dataset for SVM-based glaucoma detection.
